title: Create Maximum Number
description: Form the largest possible number of length k from two arrays by picking subsequences and merging them.
pseudocode:
1. Find max subsequence of length i from nums1 and k-i from nums2
2. Merge the two subsequences to form the largest possible result
3. Keep track of the global maximum result obtained across all valid i

steps.note: Initialize result array to compare potential maximums.
Extract max subsequence of length 2 from nums1 [3,4,6,5] -> [6,5].
Extract max subsequence of length 3 from nums2 [9,1,2,5,8,3] -> [9,8,3].
Merge [6,5] and [9,8,3] using greedy comparison to form [9,8,6,5,3].
Final maximum sequence of length 5 is identified.

fullDescription:
You are given two integer arrays nums1 and nums2 of lengths m and n respectively. nums1 and nums2 represent the digits of two numbers. You are also given an integer k.

Create the maximum number of length k <= m + n from digits of the two numbers. The relative order of the digits from the same array must be preserved.

Return an array of the k digits representing the answer.

 

Example 1:

Input: nums1 = [3,4,6,5], nums2 = [9,1,2,5,8,3], k = 5
Output: [9,8,6,5,3]

Example 2:

Input: nums1 = [6,7], nums2 = [6,0,4], k = 5
Output: [6,7,6,0,4]

Example 3:

Input: nums1 = [3,9], nums2 = [8,9], k = 3
Output: [9,8,9]

 

Constraints:

  • m == nums1.length
  • n == nums2.length
  • 1 <= m, n <= 500
  • 0 <= nums1[i], nums2[i] <= 9
  • 1 <= k <= m + n
  • nums1 and nums2 do not have leading zeros.
